label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly into host variable, which is used in URI creation at line 27 ('http://' + host). While InetAddress.getAllByName(host) performs DNS resolution and the loop checks for site-local/link-local addresses, the resolved addresses don't validate the hostname itself. An attacker can provide a hostname that resolves to external/internal IPs outside the blocked categories, enabling SSRF. The sink value 'http://' + host remains attacker-controlled throughout the data flow.

evidence.note: User input param -> host variable -> URI creation at sink line 27
